text:
scopes: []
        worker:
            implementation: scriptworker-lando
            # lando-repo is the _destination_ repository; not the one
            # the task runs on. For this reason it is keyed on behavior
            # instead of project.
            lando-repo:
                by-behavior:
                    main-to-beta: comm-beta
                    early-to-late-beta: comm-beta
                    beta-to-release: comm-release
                    release-to-esr: comm-esr140
                    bump-main: comm-central
                    bump-esr140: comm-esr140
            
            dontbuild: false
            ignore-closed-tree: true
            actions:
                by-behavior:
                    # This list of behaviours should be kept in sync with
                    # the enum in the merge_automation action.
                    bump-main:
                        - main-bump:
                              fetch-version-from: "mail/config/version.txt"
                              version-files:
                                  - filename: "mail/config/version.txt"
                                    version-bump: "major"
                                    new-suffix: 'a1'
                                  - filename: "mail/config/version_display.txt"
                                    version-bump: "major"
                                    new-suffix: 'a1'
                              replacements:
